title: US citizenship civics flashcards: all 128 questions (2025 test)
description: Every question and accepted answer on the 2025 naturalization civics test, with cards that explain the ideas behind them so you understand rather than memorise.

glossary.DMV: Department of Motor Vehicles, the state office that runs driving tests
glossary.JD: the initials the Vice President, JD Vance, uses as his first name
glossary.USSR: Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, also called the Soviet Union

notice: Questions and answers from the USCIS 2025 civics test list, a US Government work. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by USCIS or any government agency. Answers that change with elections must be checked against uscis.gov before your interview.

changelog.notes: First draft, not yet released. The current officials' names must be verified against uscis.gov before release.

checks.what: An independent audit read all 593 cards against the USCIS 2025 civics test list, the USCIS study materials and the cited laws, for accuracy and for plain English
checks.result: 11 wrong facts, 23 unsupported claims, 31 ambiguous cards (mostly "name two" questions missing accepted answers), 23 unclear ones and 177 minor issues were fixed. Every card for a "name" question now lists every accepted answer word for word. The officials’ names must still be checked against uscis.gov before release.
